summary: Kootenai NF lookout in Lincoln County, MT: an L-4 cab dated 1934, described by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1940; listed gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed gone by firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association; Forest Lookouts says removed; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: A trail listing describes a 1.5-mile trail to Allen Peak in the Kootenai National Forest, open on foot, by bicycle and by horse; not confirmed to reach the lookout site

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey described the lookout house in 1940, placing it 11 miles NE of Trout Creek and 8 miles SSW of Raven Ranger Station

notes_for_editor: Gone status is supported by firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts (removed) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association. The NGS listing gives the station the destroyed-surface-mark code X in the horizontal column (entry shown as XX); a second entry with code NN lists the same name. Read that as a survey-record signal, not proof about the house. The Gaia trail listing is not confirmed to reach the lookout site. No source describes what remains today. No photo found.
